masterPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a NEW ultra-photorealistic high-resolution commercial studio product photograph, a SINGLE business card, not an atlas, not a collage. Input reference is an old low-quality 3x2 variant sheet: use only its TOP LEFT business card as camera and brand reference. Upgrade photography substantially, don't upscale/reuse the low-res pixels. Same shallow elevated camera, card lies flat, long edges slope upward to the right about 16 degrees; front long edge and right short edge visible. Landscape canvas, ideally 2048x1360. Card centered, fully visible, fills 78% of canvas width with generous background around every corner; identical framing will be reused for all material variations. A physically credible 85x55mm business card, thin 350gsm crisp white stock, sharp square corners, subtle paper thickness, smooth plain paper, matte BLACK ink. Front graphic exact text: large spaced uppercase "STUDIO", underneath very small spaced uppercase "BRAND & DESIGN", centered. No other text. Beautiful authentic print product photography: optically sharp print, fine natural cellulose microtexture with subtle variation (not noise), tactile paper cut edges, soft contact shadow, realistic physically based daylight from upper left, no fake bevel, no painterly/CGI/vector appearance, no blur on any card edge. Backdrop a seamless uniform cool pale gray exact #ECEFF3; no horizon, gradient, props, extra cards, labels, borders or UI. Keep orientation of reference, do not flatten or distort aspect ratio. One ordinary classic white business card only.
backgroundExtraction: Remove only background, preserve full card, camera, text and translucent contact shadow; true transparent RGBA.
